verdict.rationale: The only accuracy claim in the evidence is a bare marketing line ('High accuracy across 57+ languages'), with no published methodology, word-error-rate benchmark, or checkable dataset. Accuracy transparency is a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, published accuracy claims come with a methodology or benchmark dataset I can check, not bare marketing numbers
